IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Thursday, August 13, 2026**

**LU-481 Indianapolis, IN** — This board is singing. Thirty-four calls, 138 hands, and Industrial Electric is running 12 JWs each at the Eli Lilly K153 Southside and Lebanon LP1 projects on serious schedules (6–10s Mon-Sat and 7–10s rotating Sundays). Ermco's Google Data Center Mooresville run is 5–10s with Saturday, double-time OT if you log all hours. Fluor's Lebanon crew is pulling **$53.8/hr** plus **10% above scale per diem**. Book is tight.

**LU-291 Boise, ID** — VECA's META 3&5 Idaho play is **$65.33/hr** with MOU incentive OT premium. EC Electric's Micron Idaho pushes **$45.33/hr** plus **$170/day PD** (7 days if eligible) and a **$20/hr incentive** on a 60/60/50 grind. Twenty-two calls total; hands are needed. Specialty play with real PLA teeth.

**LU-430 Racine, WI** — Four contractors stacked on Microsoft Mount Pleasant, all paying **$62.51/hr**: Gerdes (22), Pieper (13), Staff (10), Kelso Burnett (8). Starts are locked. Eleven calls, 76 hands. Wisconsin reciprocal accepted. Solid, repeatable work.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** — Nine calls, 86 hands. Summit Line's Project Miner near Santa Teresa is **$55/hr** with **$1,121/week PD** for travelers 350+ miles out; Rosendin's Meta El Paso runs **$40/hr** base plus **$15 incentive** for 90% of 60/week (60/60/50 rotation). Jag and Mass Electric also in the mix. Small board, real money.

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA** — Fifty-seven calls, 306 hands, all rated. Inglett & Stubbs holding 41 at QTS Fayette and 20 at Wellstar Paulding Hospital, all **$40/hr** (4–10s and 2–8s Mon-Sat). Miller TN's Cable Splicer role is **$40.9/hr**, requires three years documented. Hospital work plus data center tray pulls.

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI** — Cupertino and MJ Electric stacked at Port Washington Data Center, both offering **JW wage plus $10/hr base increase** on 58–60 hour weeks. Thirty calls, 184 hands. Service truck work available too. Data center premium holding.

The market is drilling down on data centers and tech infrastructure—Boise's $65 META rate proves it. Hands are chasing scale, per diem, and 60-hour weeks. Indie and hospital work still alive but secondary.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Thursday, August 13, 2026**

**LU-71 Columbus, OH** is running the board right now — 46 calls with 140 hands hungry. NEW RIVER ELECTRIC CORP is the anchor, posting 40 Journeyman Lineman on distribution work across Columbus with $125 per diem for nights stayed, plus a $125 bonus on 10-hour days, running 6-10s with a CDL requirement. Same contractor's got another 9 JW slots down in Southern Ohio, 4-10s with optional Friday and Saturday, same PD. CAPITAL ELECTRIC LINE BUILDERS dropped 6 more for cable splicing in Johnstown with $100 daily per diem. This is volume work — distro, not sexy, but steady.

**LU-291 Boise, ID** is playing the data-center long game. VECA Electric's META 3&5 jobs are posting **$65.33/hr** with an incentive program and OT premium pay. EC Electric's running the Micron play at **$45.33/hr** base plus $20/hr, hitting a **60/60/50 schedule** with $170 daily per diem, 7 days if you qualify. 20 calls total, 77 hands on the board — tight ratio, which means movement.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** has Parsons Electric running 44 Inside JW at the Polaris Forge Data Center in Harwood, **$44.8/hr** with $100/day incentive Monday through Friday and $150 Saturday-Sunday. ND license bumps your per diem another $100/day. Hunt Electric's adding 10 more at the Air Base, same rate, same incentive structure. 25 calls, 139 hands — book's holding but not bloated.

**LU-70 Forestville, MD** is the outlier: only 10 calls but one transmission job is screaming — JW Didado posting 20 Journeyman Lineman in Old Field, WV at **$126/hr**, **$150 per diem**, transmission line operations. That's the sharp end of the pay scale right now.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** has Summit Line's Project Miner in Santa Teresa, New Mexico at **$55/hr**, bumping to **$65/hr** if you're 350-plus miles out, with **$1121.00 weekly per diem** for distance travelers. All OT double time. 9 calls, 86 hands — thin board, concentrated work.

The money's following data centers and transmission infrastructure — Vegas/Boise/Grand Forks are pulling hands hard, and transmission's last stand is paying.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Thursday, August 13, 2026**

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** is moving volume. Eighteen calls, 61 hands needed—BCS Mechanical is the heavyweight here, pulling 15 Journeyman Pipefitters and 13 Journeyman Plumbers on the Sego Project (West Valley), all locked into 4-10s starting August 3 with OT baked in. DSI's got 6 more Journeyman Pipefitters on the QTS data center (Eagle Mountain) running a grind—5-8s weekdays, then 5-10s plus one 8-hour swing. **$10.00** on that DSI call is thin, but the volume's real.

**LU-290 Portland, OR** sits at 21 calls chasing 30 hands—your biggest board relative to available labor. Charter's running 4 Orbital Welders for tool install at Intel Ronler Acres (Hillsboro); PermaCold needs 3 Refrig Service Techs in Portland Metro. It's specialty work—BIM Detailing, orbital welding—so Book 1 likely tight if you've got the ticket.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** shows 10 calls on 35 hands with real industrial staying power. Graham's got 10 Pipefitters on Cenovus Maintenance (4-10s, spotty OT); Gem's running Combo Welders through their fab shop (6-10s) with testing required. Nooter's stacking calls—fab shop, Cenovus, and a data center contract rolling through 9-9-26. **$53.00** on the Graham Cenovus call is solid.

**LU-208 Denver, CO** and **LU-213 St John, NB** are both thin on posted scale but heavy on specialty credentials. Denver's Harris job (Waterfall) pays PD **$125** if you're over 100 miles; St John's Irving Oil Refinery work requires F3/F4 welder testing, day-shift Instrument Tech and Pipefitter slots opening up.

**LU-192 Cheyenne, WY** is micro (2 calls, 6 hands), but PMI's Box Elder and Sturgis jobs both run **$100/day per diem** for days worked—South Dakota work always plays different.

The money's following industrial process piping and data center fab—refineries, semiconductor tool installs, and combo fabrication shops are where the overtime lives right now.
